defects_from_review.P1: Existing output hard link aliases same inode as input but in-place write truncated input
defects_from_review.P2: large train/test times high epochs accepted despite backend fixed 120s timeout

after_fix.source_alias_policy: Path identity + os.path.samefile for existing outputs; symlinks refused
after_fix.output_write_policy: private same-directory temporary report, fsync, os.replace; no O_TRUNC of preexisting inode
after_fix.timeout_handling: caught and reported as evaluation refused (exit 2)
after_fix.test_data: synthetic temporary train/test/report files, never original user input
after_fix.full_suite_execution: disposable /tmp repository copy excluding .git, build, models, data/external

boundaries: A workload proxy is not a wall-clock SLA; slower devices may still time out safely.
No formal guarantee against a malicious same-user process racing on source/parent directory paths.
No personal source content was tested or uploaded; original user files remain outside test execution.
Does not independently establish downstream human benefit or arbitrary path-tree security.
